name: baoyu-slide-deck
tagline_zh: 你说要点，它出大纲；再等片刻，整组幻灯片图就位。不用模板，不调格式，连配色都替你操心。
tagline_en: Give it bullet points, get a styled deck—outline, slides, and colors, all handled.
desc_en: Generates professional slide deck images from content. Creates outlines with style instructions, then generates individual slide images. Use when user asks to "create slides", "make a presentation", "generate deck", "slide deck", or "PPT".
why_zh: 同类工具只给模板，它却先拆解内容再逐页生成，风格指令内嵌，改稿不重画。
why_en: Others give templates; it builds from your content, embedding style per slide—so edits don't restart.
